verdict.rationale: Anytype ships its own local API with a published OpenAPI spec. It covers spaces, objects, properties, types, templates, chats and files, alongside a gRPC API, a headless CLI and an official MCP server, so much of the core data model is programmable. Nothing documents full parity with the UI, and several UI features have no evidenced API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of web publishing, sharing/collaboration invites, import/export, graph, widgets and sidebar configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Learn how to query, retrieve, and update spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates to build powerful extensions.

run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting
